INSERT INTO scrim.team_members(
            team_id, participant_id, role, is_captain, is_bench
        )
        VALUES($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
        ON CONFLICT(team_id, participant_id) DO UPDATE SET
            role = excluded.role,
            is_captain = excluded.is_captain,
            is_bench = excluded.is_bench
